usedFor: Shopify raises product events, and Together receives prompts for a model through “Create image” and “Create Embedding”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product” in Shopify, then “Create image” in Together
bestTemplate.why: A new product can get a generated image from a prompt built from its details.

watchOut: “Create image” in Together needs a prompt, so build one from the product fields rather than leaving it empty.
